_about: Canonical prompt blocks for the Ghost Ship / Skyglass / Crownhold collection (ART_BIBLE.md section 10). state/skyglass_art/build_art_batch.py pastes these verbatim; edit here, never in a generated prompt. Character identities live in roster.json. Anchor: the original crew, Deck Warden to the Crowned Captain (RUL-2026-10-26-002).
status: PROPOSED v0.4 (art director handoff 2026-10-26), awaiting director acceptance
style_character: Style: Edo-era Japanese fantasy ninja, premium pixel art matching the original Skyglass crew in density and darkness: fine, deliberate pixel clusters, hard dark outlines about one art pixel wide, flat cel shading in two or three value steps per material, limited palette; no chunky retro sprite, no smoothing, no bloom, no airbrush. Colour: night-ink and deep indigo cloth, storm-grey iron, weathered leather; pale skyglass cyan only where it is materially there (eyes, a skyglass part, a chakra-worked edge); rope only for functional lashings and containers. Full body, eye level, front three-quarter view, inside the frame with a clear margin; grounded adult anatomy, readable at 125 px; both arms within the silhouette.
costume_character: Costume (common crew language, not a uniform): Edo shinobi layered kimono, haori, hakama or fitted wraps; a cloth mask; a hood, headwrap or hat; an indigo waist sash; closed tabi with wrapped shins; practical arm protection; plain lacquered armour only where the subject asks for it, never ornate parade armour; torn hems and sash ends may show movement. The head described in the subject replaces these defaults. One dominant weapon or working tool. Solid gloved hands with five fingers.
regular: Rank: a regular shinobi, lean and agile; the head, the weapon or tool and the action carry his identity.
commander: Rank: a commander, about a tenth taller than a regular, NOT wider: a structured raised collar, a longer split haori, a controlled battle stance; no oversized shoulder plates, no gold, no crown.
division_I: Division I, Armoury: an angular, aggressive silhouette, a short split coat, the weapon prominent.
division_II: Division II, Research: a narrow, vertical, asymmetric silhouette, scroll and seal equipment.
division_III: Division III, High Command: a clean directional silhouette, disciplined weapon handling, restrained straight coat panels.
division_IV: Division IV, Sanctum: a severe enclosed silhouette, the darkest clothing, straight seal panels, almost no accessories.
material_accent: Division material: {name} ({hex}) as a subdued, non-glowing cloth or lacquer shade on trim and panels; pale skyglass cyan stays the only luminous colour.
impression: He is a fully solid shinobi recalled as a chakra impression, with normal anatomy and equipment; the only signs are small chakra-lit eyes and a faint haze at the cloth's torn edges.
chakra: Chakra, if any, is compact and purposeful, at a working blade, tool or hand; no free-floating spell effects.
negative_character: Negative: no electronic or futuristic objects, no terminals, screens, cables, laboratory machinery or futuristic weapons, no transparent body, no floating limbs, no ghost hands, no glowing seams or veins, no crystal skin, no glitch effects, no threads or lines from the head, no gold, no filigree, no jewellery, no tassels, no crown, no ornate parade armour, no headband, no forehead protector, no clan or village symbol, no text, no bare toes, no aura or halo, no rainbow accents, no realistic or smooth painterly rendering, no anime-scaled eyes, no blur, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow on the key colour, no key-colour spill, no second character, no undead imagery (no rot, bones, skulls or grave motifs), no sheet, no grid.
key_avatar: On a true solid flat magenta chroma key background (#FF00FF) covering the entire canvas, not transparent, not checkerboard. Square 1024 x 1024.
reference_character: STYLE: the original crew's look (rendering, palette, outline weight, outfit language and proportions); this is a different person, whose head, gear and weapons are described by the text
reference_object: PIXEL STYLE: rendering, outline weight, shading and the rope, wood and lacquered-metal materials only (an object of the same crew)
